## Highlights

- Expose the selected run's own Run ID separately from Source run in desktop Activity details, matching the first-task correlation workflow.
- Supply a complete local snapshot setup, captured-output inspection, missing-input failure and same-task recovery guide, linked from installation, CLI and desktop documentation.
- Align Wails runtime and every local, CI and release build CLI on 2.17.1 (#424), including the upstream Linux child-frame IPC bridge correction. Application exposure has not been demonstrated; same-origin child frames retain their origin authority.
- Retain YAML 3.0.6 and desktop/site Node types 26.6.6, and incorporate pflag 1.1.0, desktop plugin-react 6.2.1/Vitest 5.1.0, Fumadocs core/UI 16.17.10, Mermaid 12.3.0, Next 16.4.5 and Tailwind/PostCSS 4.3.4 with coherent manifests and lockfiles.
- Stabilize first-task browser navigation and retain produced failure diagnostics/review captures under per-test output paths (#429). Correct the selected Pages action's effective ten-minute deadline and retain attributable failed/recovered deployment receipts without reducing other verification allowances (#430).
- Preserve current-only storage initialization, valid-state persistence, explicit obsolete-state refusal and local IPC permissions. No state format, command/API contract or clustered-execution change. Original Windows runtime/prerequisite and inspection causes remain unconfirmed in [#355](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/355) and [#356](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/356). Attended native observations remain untested under the standing native-testing waiver; automated CI and artifact checks remain required.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v2.0.1/CHANGELOG.md#201---2026-11-06) for every change.
